OUTPUT.description: Folder of gate.json and record.json when --out and --record are not given.

OSF_NOW.description: The current time, like 2026-01-01T05:00:00Z, for escalation and expiry. Default: the clock.

PORT.description: serve: the port the HTTP server listens on.

GATEKEEPER_OPA.description: The OPA 1.x program that evaluates the policy.

GATEKEEPER_SLACK_ADAPTER.description: The command line of the channel port's slack adapter, which reaches Slack for a slack: channel (ADR 0062).

GATEKEEPER_SLACK_URL.description: Base URL of the Slack Web API, ending in a slash: the adapter's CHANNEL_API_URL. Default: the adapter's, https://slack.com/api/.

GATEKEEPER_SLACK_TOKEN.description: Slack bot token with chat:write and channels:history: the adapter's CHANNEL_TOKEN. Required for a slack: channel.

GATEKEEPER_SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET.description: serve: the signing secret of the Slack app, the adapter's CHANNEL_SIGNING_SECRET, which checks every request from Slack. Required for serve with a Slack channel.

GATEKEEPER_FORGE_ADAPTER.description: The command line of the forge port's adapter for --pull-request (ADR 0062). Default: npx -y @opensoftware/forge-github for github.com, npx -y @opensoftware/forge-forgejo for any other host.

GATEKEEPER_FORGE_URL.description: The forge adapter's FORGE_URL. serve: the server's only forge; a request's link counts as a pull request only on its origin (github.com for https://api.github.com), and no other host is called. Default: https://api.github.com; for --pull-request, https://api.github.com for github.com and the pull request's origin for Forgejo.

GATEKEEPER_FORGE_TOKEN.description: The forge adapter's FORGE_TOKEN: a token that may read the pull request and its checks (on GitHub: Checks: read, since the adapter's pr lists the check runs), comment on it and set its commit status. serve: with it, a request that links a pull request of GATEKEEPER_FORGE_URL's forge is asked on the pull request. Never written to a file.

GATEKEEPER_POLL_MS.description: serve: the milliseconds between two reads of the comments of the pull requests with a pending gate (ADR 0080). Only with GATEKEEPER_FORGE_TOKEN.

GATEKEEPER_SIGNING_KEY.description: The Ed25519 private key that signs each record: in PEM, as gatekeeper keys writes it, or its seed in 64 hex digits, like the output of openssl rand -hex 32. Without it the record is unsigned, and serve says so once at its start.

GATEKEEPER_NATS_URL.description: NATS server, like nats://localhost:4222, for the events gate.requested@v1 and gate.decided@v1. Unset: no events. serve keeps them in its outbox while NATS is unreachable.

GATEKEEPER_DATABASE_URL.description: serve: the PostgreSQL database, like postgres://gatekeeper@db/gatekeeper, for the gates and the outbox. Required for serve.

GATEKEEPER_API_TOKEN.description: serve: the token that callers of the API send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Required for serve. Never written to a file.

GATEKEEPER_PERSON_KEYS.description: serve: the issuers of person proofs as name=url pairs of their key sets, separated by commas, like console=http://console:8080/.well-known/jwks.json (ADR 0151). With it, each decision through the API needs the header OSF-Person, a proof of the person that one of them signed. Unset: a caller with the API token names any person.
